doubts: Network: the page describes two tracks to the same hut, each with its own heading, time and distance, so each is its own way; the Dawson Falls way is main. Both start from a place the text names (the visitor centre, and the Stratford Mountain House under the East Egmont heading) and end at Waingongoro Hut. The visitor centre is matched to the place entry Dawson Falls (T7), which sits at the visitor centre; the Stratford Mountain House is matched to East Egmont (T8) from the heading; both are judgements. The Dawson Falls way can return the same way or via Wilkies Pools; the page gives only that return option, so it is not a separate way and the way is one way to the hut. The alternate access via the Kapuni Loop Track entrance is an access point onto the Ridge Track, matched to road end F3 (where the Kapuni Loop Track meets Manaia Road). The Kapuni Stream is rock hopped (ford) because the text says so, with no bridge given; the bridge lower down it is only in the alternate access, which is not recorded as a via. The several unbridged streams on the East Egmont way are recorded as a ford with a null name. The time and distance are per heading, copied as given.
